command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import io, tarfile, re
p='/app/varsea/disks/sub1/subA/subAlpha/ae3f4c.dat'
data=open(p,'rb').read()
print('size',len(data))
# find tar headers
offs=[]
i=0
while True:
    j=data.find(b'ustar',i)
    if j<0: break
    offs.append(j-257)
    i=j+1
print('tar header offsets:',offs)
cands=[]
for off in offs:
    try:
        tf=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data[off:]),mode='r:')
    except Exception as e:
        print('open fail at',off,e); continue
    for m in tf.getmembers():
        print('MEMBER',m.name,m.size,m.isreg())
        if m.isreg():
            c=tf.extractfile(m).read()
            print('CONTENT',repr(c))
            for mm in re.finditer(rb'PASSWORD=([A-Z0-9]+)',c):
                cands.append((m.name,mm.group(1).decode()))
print('CANDIDATES',cands)
# also all raw occurrences of PASSWORD= anywhere
for mm in re.finditer(rb'PASSWORD=',data):
    print('RAW',mm.start(),repr(data[mm.start():mm.start()+80]))
EOF

echo '=== tools ==='; for t in python python2 python3 perl tar gzip gunzip zcat xxd hexdump od strings file busybox; do printf '%-10s ' "$t"; command -v "$t" || echo MISSING; done; echo '=== file type ==='; file /app/varsea/disks/sub1/subA/subAlpha/ae3f4c.dat 2>&1; echo '=== header dump around PASSWORD (offset 256..1024) ==='; dd if=/app/varsea/disks/sub1/subA/subAlpha/ae3f4c.dat bs=1 skip=0 count=1200 2>/dev/null | od -A d -c | head -80

printf '%s\n' '8XDP5Q2RT9Z' > /app/recovered_passwords.txt
echo "draft written: $(cat /app/recovered_passwords.txt)"
for off in 1048544 3145696 259840 4150304; do
  echo "=== context at offset $off (0x$(printf '%x' $off)) ==="
  dd if="$f" bs=1 skip=$off count=320 2>/dev/null | od -A d -t x1z
done
echo '=== structure signatures ==='
perl -0777 -ne 'for my $sig ("PK\x03\x04","PK\x01\x02","PK\x05\x06","ustar","PASSWORD=") { my $i=0; while((my $p=index($_,$sig,$i))>=0){ printf "%s at %d (0x%x)\n",$sig,$p,$p; $i=$p+1; } }' "$f"
echo '=== uppercase/digit runs >= 10 ==='
perl -0777 -ne 'while(/([A-Z0-9]{10,})/g){ printf "RUN off=%d len=%d [%s]\n",$-[1],length($1),$1; }' "$f" | head -80

dd if="$f" bs=1 skip=1048652 count=33 2>/dev/null | od -A x -t x1z
printf '%s\n' '8XDP5Q2RT9ZK7VB3BV4WW54' > /app/recovered_passwords.txt

done < /app/recovered_passwords.txt
